import { Controller, Injectable, Module, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { EventEmitter2, EventEmitterModule, OnEvent } from '@nestjs/event-emitter';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Entity, Repository } from 'typeorm';

const DYNAMIC_OPTIONS = runtimeOptions();
declare function runtimeOptions(): unknown;

@Entity('event_effect')
class EventEffect {}

@Injectable()
class DotHandlers {
  constructor(@InjectRepository(EventEffect) private readonly repository: Repository<EventEffect>) {}

  @OnEvent('order.created') exact(): void { void this.repository.save({ handler: 'exact' }); }
  @OnEvent('order.*') singleOne(): void { void this.repository.save({ handler: 'single-one' }); }
  @OnEvent('order.*') singleTwo(): void { void this.repository.save({ handler: 'single-two' }); }
  @OnEvent('order.**') deep(): void { void this.repository.save({ handler: 'deep' }); }
  @OnEvent('*.created') suffix(): void { void this.repository.save({ handler: 'suffix' }); }
}

@Controller('wildcards')
class DotController {
  constructor(private readonly events: EventEmitter2) {}

  @Post('dot-created') dotCreated(): void { this.events.emit('order.created'); }
  @Post('dot-deep') dotDeep(): void { this.events.emit('order.item.created'); }
  @Post('dot-root') dotRoot(): void { this.events.emit('order'); }
}

@Injectable()
class CustomHandlers {
  constructor(@InjectRepository(EventEffect) private readonly repository: Repository<EventEffect>) {}

  @OnEvent('order::*') single(): void { void this.repository.save({ handler: 'custom-single' }); }
  @OnEvent('order::**') deep(): void { void this.repository.save({ handler: 'custom-deep' }); }
}

@Controller('wildcards')
class CustomController {
  constructor(private readonly events: EventEmitter2) {}

  @Post('custom') publish(): void { this.events.emit('order::created'); }
}

@Injectable()
class DisabledHandler {
  @OnEvent('order.*') literalOnly(): void {}
}

@Controller('wildcards')
class DisabledController {
  constructor(private readonly events: EventEmitter2) {}

  @Post('disabled') publish(): void { this.events.emit('order.created'); }
}

@Injectable()
class DynamicHandler {
  @OnEvent('order.*') unknown(): void {}
}

@Controller('wildcards')
class DynamicController {
  constructor(private readonly events: EventEmitter2) {}

  @Post('dynamic') publish(): void { this.events.emit('order.created'); }
}

@Module({
  imports: [EventEmitterModule.forRoot({ wildcard: true })],
  controllers: [DotController],
  providers: [DotHandlers],
})
class DotModule {}

const CUSTOM_EVENT_OPTIONS = { wildcard: true, delimiter: '::' } as const;
@Module({
  imports: [EventEmitterModule.forRoot(CUSTOM_EVENT_OPTIONS)],
  controllers: [CustomController],
  providers: [CustomHandlers],
})
class CustomModule {}

@Module({
  imports: [EventEmitterModule.forRoot({ wildcard: false })],
  controllers: [DisabledController],
  providers: [DisabledHandler],
})
class DisabledModule {}

@Module({
  imports: [EventEmitterModule.forRoot(DYNAMIC_OPTIONS)],
  controllers: [DynamicController],
  providers: [DynamicHandler],
})
class DynamicModule {}

async function bootstrap(): Promise<void> {
  await NestFactory.create(DotModule);
  await NestFactory.create(CustomModule);
  await NestFactory.create(DisabledModule);
  await NestFactory.create(DynamicModule);
}
